title: OHC Projection
description: What one grantee receives for one purpose at one time; the only form in which OHC content leaves the holder. Statements and interpretations travel in separate members. It never reports counts or what was withheld. Module governance.

subjectAlias.description: Pairwise per grantee. The subject id is never included.

ownProposals.description: Present only on a proposer view (§12.5): the projection also carries the grantee's own proposed records and those that expired undecided, labelled pending or not-accepted. Never served onward.

derived.description: One entry per served record, with its computed status and derived label.

endorsedPart.description: The person's words on a partly endorsed record: the text of the latest partially-endorse Review (PJ-8).

absences.description: One entry per requested selector the grant does not cover, whether or not matching records exist (R-G5).

decisionUse.description: Copied from the grant; deny when the grant has no decisionUse (R-G14).

digest.description: sha256 over the JCS form of the projection without digest.
